stroke_in.note: Wikipedia (citing Hemmings) and Mac's Motor City Garage give 4.125 in; arithmetic settles it: 3.875 x 3.875 x 4.25 x 0.7854 x 4 = 200.5 ci (matches every published displacement); 4.125 would give 194.6 ci. 4.25 in = 108.0 mm.
